text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, Mr. C.B. and the Trainer run 
into the young channel operator. He was 
arguing with another man over Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young man speaks. He had hoped Mr. 
C.B. would become a legendary Umamusume. 
However, Symboli Rudolf arrived on the 
scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She accepted the consensus that Symboli 
Rudolf was strong. However, being told 
that Mr. C.B. was washed up made her lose 
her temper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. points out that the young man 
wants her to be his ideal Umamusume. And 
that he's entirely free to watch her races 
however he likes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race track is the freest place in the 
world. Therefore, both she and he should 
enjoy that world however they pleased— 
that was her philosophy.
